## Candidate concepts for the Phase 2 pilot

- brief inference before selecting a visual direction;
- variance, motion, and density reasoning;
- anti-default visual review;
- audit-first redesign behavior;
- cross-page layout-family and rhythm review;
- a presentation-specific preflight checklist.

## Excluded concepts

- React, Next.js, Tailwind, Motion, GSAP, navigation, CTA, form, mobile, and web-performance instructions;
- AIDA as a mandatory structure;
- mandatory randomization and static-is-failure behavior;
- global bans on punctuation, equal peer layouts, icon authoring, SVG construction, or any other PPT Master capability;
- any second route, confirmation system, template policy, motion policy, or QA authority.

## Promotion boundary

The Phase 2 workspace remains explicit and unregistered. Only concepts that pass the Phase 3 A/B evaluation may enter a global PPT Master reference.

See `LICENSE` in this directory for the upstream license text.
